text_blocks.snippet: Central Illinois residents are currently targeted by fake local service providers, government impersonation calls, and fraudulent mailers.

list.snippet: Fake Garage Repair Services: Scammers set up sponsored Google ads posing as local repair companies, showing up and inflating modest repair bills into thousands of dollars.

Government & Law Enforcement Impersonation: Callers and texters pretend to be the Illinois Secretary of State, local sheriffs, or federal agencies claiming you have an arrest warrant or owe immediate bond money.
Gas and Food Vouchers: Fraudulent mailers circulate promising rewards or vouchers in exchange for an upfront "processing fee".
Phishing & Brushing Scams: Unsolicited QR codes arrive via mail ("brushing") or text messages pretending to be from MyChart, Medicare, or the Department of Revenue.
Practice the pause: Take a moment to verify urgent requests instead of acting under pressure.
Never pay upfront fees: Legitimate agencies or rewards do not require a fee to cash in.
Verify local businesses: Look up physical addresses and independent licenses rather than clicking the first sponsored search result.
Contact authorities: Report fraud directly to the Better Business Bureau of Central Illinois or the Illinois Secretary of State.
